notes.title: 🔥Major Version Update｜Desert Rescue Battle Officially Begins!
notes.content:
[p]The flames of war are about to reignite, and the Kingdom is once again in crisis!

Beneath the guise of peace, the Dark Faction has already laid out an inescapable net. In this brand-new version, you will delve deep into unknown desert territories to rescue the exiled Prince, help him return to the capital, and wage the final decisive battle against the long-hidden Dark Faction!

[/p][h2]This Version Update at a Glance:[/h2][p]
[/p][h3]New Desert Terrain Added[/h3][p]
Unfamiliar landscapes hide unknown dangers. Respected Viceroy, are you ready to face new challenges?

[/p][h3]10 New Aides-de-camp[/h3][p]
Each possesses unique abilities and backstories, waiting for you to unleash their potential!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921982/c013327f25938405a0b4ecc6260c57e5c50e3ea4.gif"][/img][/p][h3]40 New Cards[/h3][p] Brand-new tactical combinations and deck-building strategies to help you stand out on the desert battlefield![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921982/e356eaec4a8c70bfaf8ad7f5eecb3a3cdeddff04.png"][/img]
[/p][h3]30 New Enemies[/h3][p]
Monsters formed from sand and magic await your challenge

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921982/d2bfa8b91a89cdc4dc20678278a2687abf7cc5ed.gif"][/img][/p][h3]28 Chest Upgrades[/h3][p]
Unlock more strategic options and resource acquisition paths!

[/p][h3]7 New Main Story Missions[/h3][p]
Venture deep into the desert to uncover the truth behind the Dark Faction’s conspiracy!

[/p][h3]Exploration Mechanics Completely Revamped![/h3][p]
In the DLC map, the monthly quest system will be replaced by a brand-new exploration gameplay, bringing more strategic challenges!

[b][h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3][/b]
Adjustments have been made to numerous in-game stats for balancing purposes

[/p][h2]⚔️Are you ready to face new challenges? The fate of the Kingdom rests on your shoulders!
[/h2][p]

notes.title: 🎊 100,000 Copies, Thank You! 🎊
notes.content:
We have officially sold over 100,000 copies of Border Pioneer! That's over 100,000 of you people supporting us, thank you all! From humble beginnings to this incredible milestone, we couldn't have done it without our amazing community.


[h3]🎉 Celebrate With Us![/h3]

To mark this special occasion, we're offering [b]30% OFF[/b] Border Pioneer for a limited time! Whether you're a seasoned pioneer looking to gift the experience to friends or a newcomer ready to stake your claim on the frontier, there's never been a better time to get into the game.

With this milestone, the journey is far from over. The team is working towards updates and improvements based on your valuable feedback. Stay tuned for what's coming!

notes.title: ⚔️ "Border Pioneer" x "Desperate Place" Bundle is Live!
notes.content:
Brave commanders, do you hear the call of the frontlines? It’s time to build and defend your very own base!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921982/624390deea96adae189bc4d5001bd8f477212d31.jpg[/img]

🎮 "Border Pioneer" is a pixel-style city-building game that blends survival with defense elements. As a rookie pioneer, your mission is to prove your worth and bring glory to the kingdom. In the untamed wilderness of the frontier, you’ll face dangerous threats, carefully manage resources, construct your town, and create an unbreakable defense line.

🎮 "Desperate Place" is a sci-fi base-building tower defense game. You’ll step into the shoes of a crew member who’s been prematurely awakened from cryosleep. Stranded on an unknown planet after your colony ship is damaged, you’ll gather resources, repair the ship, battle alien monstrosities, and escape this desolate nightmare.

[h2]🔥 Grab the bundle now and enjoy a limited-time discount![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/52867/_/

If you’re a fan of base-building and strategy tower defense games, this is the one you don’t want to miss!

notes.title: Patch v0.99.33
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Demon Priests now kill demonic sacrifices to summon Imps, and their skill’s effect range has been reduced.
[*] Added a Monster Strength setting in the map editor, allowing players to adjust attribute percentages for specific monster waves.
[*] Upgrading the Dragon Nest’s skills will now increase the Baby Dragon’s max health and food consumption.
[*] Fixed a bug where large negative gold values during the settlement phase would deduct experience points.
[*] Optimized the map editor interface: spawn point settings can now be moved up/down, and copy logic has been revised.
[*] Fixed untranslated text for critically injured units 
[*] Attempted to fix a bug where the monster list displayed incorrect quantities.
[*] Increased the number of enemies hit per attack for Berserkers and Axe Throwers.
[*] Now you can set victory objectives and map parameters for custom maps.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.99.32

[*] Removed the healing effect from the Giant Mushy (this can still be weakened via bonfires).
[*] Fixed a bug where the Output Crown would disappear.
[*] Reduced penalties for festival events.
[*] Fixed an issue where units would continuously call "SOS" if too many critically injured units were queued for recovery.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Giant Mushy had an incorrect attack range.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.99.30
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added supplies consumption display to unit interfaces.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Bonfire consumed supplies incorrectly. It now consumes 1 supply per turn.
[*] Golems no longer consume food and now consume supplies instead.
[*] Fixed a bug where summoned units spawned with incomplete health.
[*] Fixed a bug with incorrect Fortress upgrades.
[*] Demon Priests now significantly increase their own health cost when empowering other demons.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Blade Wall could not be attacked.
[*] Fixed a bug where Mushy could not be enhanced by Snowfield Goblins and Snowfield Orcs.
[*] Added animation effects for enhancements by Snowfield Goblins and Snowfield Orcs to make the process more visually clear to players.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.99.17

[*] Fixed a bug where the "Prince's" "Defense Command" effect incorrectly increased damage.

notes.title: The update to version 0.99.10 may cause errors in existing game sessions.
notes.content:
Due to adjustments in the save mechanism in version 0.99.10, incompatibility issues may arise in ongoing games. This could result in bugs such as incorrect monster spawn points, failure to spawn monsters properly, or incorrect display of game objectives.
These issues will be resolved when starting a new game.

notes.title: Issue regarding lost save files after macOS update
notes.content:
Restart your computer.For those who may have similar issue...try to reinstall the game and then you can grant the game access to your Documents folder and use your old savings.
If you are a macOS-arm player, you can right-click the game → Properties → Betas and select the macOS-arm test branch to play.

notes.title: New Maps Available! New Demo Brings Tons of New Content!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
Exciting news! The new demo for Border Pioneer is now available! This update brings new maps, mechanics, and a bunch of changes. Dive in and explore!

Firstly, thank you so much for your continued support and love of our game! [url=https://discord.gg/yQDPCssauZ]Join our official Discord [/url]to share your thoughts directly with us and get a chance to participate in the beta version!

We’ve made a lot of tweaks and optimizations based on your recent feedback, and we’ve also added tons of new content. 
Please share more feedback with us so we can further improve the game.

[h2]New Additions[/h2]
[list][*]More maps added

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921982/6a95f68be7a1a15de825e55f6071bf2afb479fab.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921982/bf1e542d4e1e9a23a266eda07dcdff52018d7a3f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921982/f18396ce7241a4a8b09acca07305377661b95034.gif[/img]
[*]Ice Tower now applies a “Freeze” effect when hitting enemies in the “Cold” state

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921982/b00378dcce0205716a11f30904aa012c9664bc32.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921982/a41e4685db012cddcb20a7e29aa0f93e69249b52.gif[/img]
[*]Added a "shift" shortcut for quick purchases in caravan trades
[*]More cards added to the demo version

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921982/6fb13c2d18595ebfe25fa5c3450187aae6388f51.jpg[/img]
[*]You can unlock new buildings from treasure chests
[/list]
[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[list][*]Adjusted unit population and food consumption
[*]Population maintenance costs now apply when the population exceeds 200, increasing food consumption for units and defensive buildings
[*]Card prices now rise as the number of months increases
[*]Increased the chance of drawing enhanced cards from treasure chests after selecting corresponding card enhancements
[*]Removed building upgrade options
[*]Reworked abnormal status logic, introducing "Poison Accumulation" and "Burn Accumulation" to replace most abnormal damage
[*]Modified knockback logic, larger enemies are no longer completely immune to knockback but have reduced knockback effect based on size
[*]Repair Cabin no longer affects traps
[*]Town Hall can now heal nearby units
[*]Building upgrade branches added to treasure chests, with each defensive building having 2 upgrade branches

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921982/d698d256ef8cc00e10696d34129778675fe19750.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921982/5e82e7d26dd157ced9241ed44321340929fb36d4.png[/img]
[/list]
[h2]Fixes & Optimizations[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed layer misalignment
[*]Fixed the bug where Imperial Supplies might disappear
[*]Fixed incorrect task rewards
[*]Fixed the bug where units remained after being disbanded
[*]Fixed the bug where units would appear in the top-left corner of the map after returning from tasks
[*]Fixed UI errors in the caravan trade interface
[*]Fixed UI errors in the treasure chest selection interface
[*]Optimized map generation logic
[*]Optimized unit pathfinding AI
[*]Optimized performance issues caused by a large number of units
[/list]

Thank you again for your support. If you have more suggestions and feedback, join our [url=https://discord.gg/yQDPCssauZ]official Discord[/url] 

Lastly, we’re working hard on the full version, which will feature more diverse maps, heroes, units, and buildings. We aim to complete the game soon and can’t wait to share the full version with you! Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2346410/_/

notes.title: Test Update Log：2024-04-25
notes.content:
[h1]Updates for DEMO[/h1]
- This really, really is the last update tweak for the Beta.
- Upgraded the strength of high rarity units.
- All unit upgrades will increase in experience with rarity, and the attributes gained from upgrades will increase with rarity.
- The shooting range has been removed for the time being, and shooting training cannot be acquired repeatedly
- Nerfed the blood level of enemy long-range units
- Adjusted the armour mechanic so that armour will now have a percentage damage reduction attached to it.
- Grass/wood/brick huts now give more free inhabitants.
- Rare unit added for Mages: Gorem

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)
